easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Those who deny the Day of Judgment

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: On couches, gazing,

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: And mixed with water of Tasnim,

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: And wink one to another when they passed them;

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

easy.name: Al-Mutaffifin
easy.translation: On high couches, gazing.

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: When the heaven is split asunder

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And attentive to her Lord in fear,

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And when the earth is spread out

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And attentive to her Lord in fear!

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And will return unto his folk in joy.

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: He surely will invoke destruction

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: He verily lived joyous with his folk,

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And by the moon when she is at the full,

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.

easy.name: Al-Inshiqaq
easy.translation: So give them tidings of a painful doom,

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Of the fuel-fed fire,

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: When they sat by it,

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Doer of what He will.

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.

easy.name: Al-Buruj
easy.translation: On a guarded tablet.

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: So let man consider from what he is created.

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: He is created from a gushing fluid

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: That issued from between the loins and ribs.

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: It is no pleasantry.

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)

easy.name: At-Tariq
easy.translation: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Who createth, then disposeth;

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Who measureth, then guideth;

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Then turneth it to russet stubble.

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: He will heed who feareth,

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: He who will be flung to the great Fire

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: He is successful who groweth,

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: But ye prefer the life of the world

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.

easy.name: Al-A'la
easy.translation: The Books of Abraham and Moses.

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Scorched by burning fire,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Drinking from a boiling spring,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: In that day other faces will be calm,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: In a high Garden

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Where they hear no idle speech,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Wherein is a gushing spring,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Wherein are couches raised

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: And the heaven, how it is raised?

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: And the hills, how they are set up?

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: And the earth, how it is spread?

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Thou art not at all a warder over them.

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: Lo! unto Us is their return

easy.name: Al-Ghashiyah
easy.translation: And Ours their reckoning.

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And the night when it departeth,

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: With many-columned Iram,

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And multiplied iniquity therein?

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And love wealth with abounding love.

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: None bindeth as He then will bind.

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: But ah! thou soul at peace!

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!

easy.name: Al-Fajr
easy.translation: Enter thou among My bondmen!

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: Nay, I swear by this city -

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: And thou art an indweller of this city -

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: And the begetter and that which he begat,

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: Did We not assign unto him two eyes

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: An orphan near of kin,

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: Or some poor wretch in misery,

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: Their place will be on the right hand.

easy.name: Al-Balad
easy.translation: Fire will be an awning over them.

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And the moon when she followeth him,

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And the day when it revealeth him,

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And the night when it enshroudeth him,

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And the heaven and Him Who built it,

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And the earth and Him Who spread it,

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And a soul and Him Who perfected it

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: When the basest of them broke forth

easy.name: Ash-Shams
easy.translation: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: By the night enshrouding

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: And the day resplendent

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: And Him Who hath created male and female,

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: Which only the most wretched must endure,

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: He who denieth and turneth away.

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).

easy.name: Al-Layl
easy.translation: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: And by the night when it is stillest,

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: Therefor the orphan oppress not,

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: Therefor the beggar drive not away,

easy.name: Ad-Duhaa
easy.translation: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: And eased thee of the burden

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: Which weighed down thy back;

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: And exalted thy fame?

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: So when thou art relieved, still toil

easy.name: Ash-Sharh
easy.translation: And strive to please thy Lord.

easy.name: At-Tin
easy.translation: And by this land made safe;

easy.name: At-Tin
easy.translation: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,

easy.name: At-Tin
easy.translation: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?

easy.name: At-Tin
easy.translation: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Createth man from a clot.

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Who teacheth by the pen,

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Teacheth man that which he knew not.

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Nay, but verily man is rebellious

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: That he thinketh himself independent!

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: A slave when he prayeth?

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Or enjoineth piety?

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?

easy.name: Al-'Alaq
easy.translation: The lying, sinful forelock -

easy.name: Al-Qadr
easy.translation: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.

easy.name: Al-Qadr
easy.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!

easy.name: Al-Qadr
easy.translation: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.

easy.name: Al-Bayyinah
easy.translation: Containing correct scriptures.

easy.name: Az-Zalzalah
easy.translation: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake

easy.name: Az-Zalzalah
easy.translation: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,

easy.name: Az-Zalzalah
easy.translation: And man saith: What aileth her?

easy.name: Az-Zalzalah
easy.translation: That day she will relate her chronicles,

easy.name: Az-Zalzalah
easy.translation: Because thy Lord inspireth her.

easy.name: Al-'Adiyat
easy.translation: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,

easy.name: Al-'Adiyat
easy.translation: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),

easy.name: Al-'Adiyat
easy.translation: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord

easy.name: Al-'Adiyat
easy.translation: And lo! he is a witness unto that;

easy.name: Al-'Adiyat
easy.translation: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.

easy.name: Al-'Adiyat
easy.translation: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,

easy.name: Al-'Adiyat
easy.translation: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.

easy.name: Al-Qari'ah
easy.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!

easy.name: Al-Qari'ah
easy.translation: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

easy.name: Al-Qari'ah
easy.translation: And the mountains will become as carded wool.

easy.name: Al-Qari'ah
easy.translation: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),

easy.name: Al-Qari'ah
easy.translation: He will live a pleasant life.

easy.name: Al-Qari'ah
easy.translation: But as for him whose scales are light,

easy.name: Al-Qari'ah
easy.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -

easy.name: At-Takathur
easy.translation: Until ye come to the graves.

easy.name: At-Takathur
easy.translation: Nay, but ye will come to know!

easy.name: At-Takathur
easy.translation: Nay, but ye will come to know!

easy.name: At-Takathur
easy.translation: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!

easy.name: At-Takathur
easy.translation: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.

easy.name: At-Takathur
easy.translation: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.

easy.name: Al-'Asr
easy.translation: Lo! man is a state of loss,

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: Woe unto every slandering traducer,

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: Lo! it is closed in on them

easy.name: Al-Humazah
easy.translation: In outstretched columns.

easy.name: Al-Fil
easy.translation: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,

easy.name: Al-Fil
easy.translation: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,

easy.name: Al-Fil
easy.translation: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,

easy.name: Al-Fil
easy.translation: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?

easy.name: Quraysh
easy.translation: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.

easy.name: Quraysh
easy.translation: So let them worship the Lord of this House,

easy.name: Al-Ma'un
easy.translation: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?

easy.name: Al-Ma'un
easy.translation: That is he who repelleth the orphan,

easy.name: Al-Ma'un
easy.translation: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.

easy.name: Al-Ma'un
easy.translation: Who are heedless of their prayer;

easy.name: Al-Ma'un
easy.translation: Who would be seen (at worship)

easy.name: Al-Kawthar
easy.translation: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;

easy.name: Al-Kawthar
easy.translation: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.

easy.name: Al-Kawthar
easy.translation: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.

easy.name: Al-Kafirun
easy.translation: Say: O disbelievers!

easy.name: Al-Kafirun
easy.translation: I worship not that which ye worship;

easy.name: Al-Kafirun
easy.translation: Nor worship ye that which I worship.

easy.name: Al-Kafirun
easy.translation: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.

easy.name: Al-Kafirun
easy.translation: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

easy.name: Al-Kafirun
easy.translation: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.

easy.name: An-Nasr
easy.translation: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

easy.name: Al-Masad
easy.translation: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.

easy.name: Al-Masad
easy.translation: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,

easy.name: Al-Masad
easy.translation: And his wife, the wood-carrier,

easy.name: Al-Masad
easy.translation: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.

easy.name: Al-Ikhlas
easy.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One!

easy.name: Al-Ikhlas
easy.translation: He begetteth not nor was begotten.

easy.name: Al-Ikhlas
easy.translation: And there is none comparable unto Him.

easy.name: Al-Falaq
easy.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak

easy.name: Al-Falaq
easy.translation: From the evil of that which He created;

easy.name: Al-Falaq
easy.translation: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,

easy.name: Al-Falaq
easy.translation: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,

easy.name: Al-Falaq
easy.translation: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.

easy.name: An-Nas
easy.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

easy.name: An-Nas
easy.translation: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,

easy.name: An-Nas
easy.translation: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,

easy.name: An-Nas
easy.translation: Of the jinn and of mankind.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: And to warn those who say: Allah hath chosen a son,

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: And lo! We shall make all that is thereon a barren mound.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: Then We sealed up their hearing in the Cave for a number of years.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: And say not of anything: Lo! I shall do that tomorrow,

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: And (it is said) they tarried in their Cave three hundred years and add nine.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: But He is Allah, my Lord, and I ascribe unto my Lord no partner.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: Or some morning the water thereof will be lost in the earth so that thou canst not make search for it.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: And (all) those townships! We destroyed them when they did wrong, and We appointed a fixed time for their destruction.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: He said: Lo! thou canst not bear with me.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: How canst thou bear with that whereof thou canst not compass any knowledge?

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: So (it was). And We knew all concerning him.

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it).

medium.name: Al-Kahf
medium.translation: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.

medium.name: Ya-Sin
medium.translation: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: This is hell which the guilty deny.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.

medium.name: Ar-Rahman
medium.translation: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: And if he is of those on the right hand,

medium.name: Al-Waqi'ah
medium.translation: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,

medium.name: Al-Mulk
medium.translation: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end!

medium.name: Al-Mulk
medium.translation: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up,

medium.name: Al-Mulk
medium.translation: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.

medium.name: Al-Mulk
medium.translation: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!

medium.name: Al-Mulk
medium.translation: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.

medium.name: Al-Mulk
medium.translation: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.

medium.name: Al-Qalam
medium.translation: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!

medium.name: Al-Haqqah
medium.translation: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.

medium.name: Al-Ma'arij
medium.translation: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,

medium.name: Nuh
medium.translation: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

medium.name: Nuh
medium.translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

medium.name: Nuh
medium.translation: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.

medium.name: Nuh
medium.translation: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.

medium.name: Nuh
medium.translation: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

medium.name: Nuh
medium.translation: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,

medium.name: Nuh
medium.translation: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

medium.name: Al-Jinn
medium.translation: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.

medium.name: Al-Jinn
medium.translation: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.

medium.name: Al-Jinn
medium.translation: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

medium.name: Al-Jinn
medium.translation: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.

medium.name: Al-Jinn
medium.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.

medium.name: Al-Jinn
medium.translation: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.

medium.name: Al-Jinn
medium.translation: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,

medium.name: Al-Muzzammil
medium.translation: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.

medium.name: Al-Muddaththir
medium.translation: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.

medium.name: Al-Muddaththir
medium.translation: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;

medium.name: Al-Muddaththir
medium.translation: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.

medium.name: Al-Muddaththir
medium.translation: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.

medium.name: Al-Qiyamah
medium.translation: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!

medium.name: Al-Qiyamah
medium.translation: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.

medium.name: Al-Qiyamah
medium.translation: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.

medium.name: Al-Qiyamah
medium.translation: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?

medium.name: Al-Qiyamah
medium.translation: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.

medium.name: Al-Insan
medium.translation: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.

medium.name: Al-Mursalat
medium.translation: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?

medium.name: Al-Mursalat
medium.translation: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;

medium.name: Al-Mursalat
medium.translation: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,

medium.name: Al-Mursalat
medium.translation: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.

medium.name: Al-Mursalat
medium.translation: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.

medium.name: Al-Mursalat
medium.translation: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.

medium.name: Al-Mursalat
medium.translation: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!

medium.name: An-Naba
medium.translation: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,

medium.name: An-Naba
medium.translation: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink

medium.name: An-Naba
medium.translation: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -

medium.name: An-Nazi'at
medium.translation: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,

medium.name: An-Nazi'at
medium.translation: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?

medium.name: An-Nazi'at
medium.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.

medium.name: An-Nazi'at
medium.translation: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?

medium.name: 'Abasa
medium.translation: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).

medium.name: At-Takwir
medium.translation: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,

medium.name: At-Takwir
medium.translation: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.

medium.name: Al-Infitar
medium.translation: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,

medium.name: Al-Infitar
medium.translation: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.

medium.name: Al-Infitar
medium.translation: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,

medium.name: Al-Mutaffifin
medium.translation: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?

medium.name: Al-Inshiqaq
medium.translation: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).

medium.name: Al-Inshiqaq
medium.translation: But whoso is given his account behind his back,

medium.name: Al-Inshiqaq
medium.translation: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!

medium.name: Al-Inshiqaq
medium.translation: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?

medium.name: Al-Buruj
medium.translation: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.

medium.name: At-Tariq
medium.translation: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.

medium.name: At-Tariq
medium.translation: Then will he have no might nor any helper.

medium.name: Al-A'la
medium.translation: Wherein he will neither die nor live.

medium.name: Al-Ghashiyah
medium.translation: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit

medium.name: Al-Ghashiyah
medium.translation: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.

medium.name: Al-Ghashiyah
medium.translation: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?

medium.name: Al-Fajr
medium.translation: There surely is an oath for thinking man.

medium.name: Al-Fajr
medium.translation: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,

medium.name: Al-Fajr
medium.translation: The like of which was not created in the lands;

medium.name: Al-Fajr
medium.translation: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan

medium.name: Al-Fajr
medium.translation: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,

medium.name: Al-Balad
medium.translation: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?

medium.name: Al-Balad
medium.translation: And to feed in the day of hunger.

medium.name: Al-Balad
medium.translation: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.

medium.name: Ash-Shams
medium.translation: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!

medium.name: Ash-Shams
medium.translation: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).

medium.name: Al-Layl
medium.translation: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.

medium.name: Al-Layl
medium.translation: And none hath with him any favour for reward,

medium.name: At-Tin
medium.translation: Surely We created man of the best stature

medium.name: Al-'Alaq
medium.translation: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -

medium.name: Al-'Alaq
medium.translation: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).

medium.name: Al-Qadr
medium.translation: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

medium.name: Al-Bayyinah
medium.translation: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

medium.name: Az-Zalzalah
medium.translation: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.

medium.name: Az-Zalzalah
medium.translation: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,

medium.name: Az-Zalzalah
medium.translation: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.

medium.name: Al-'Adiyat
medium.translation: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth

medium.name: Al-Fil
medium.translation: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?

medium.name: Quraysh
medium.translation: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

medium.name: An-Nasr
medium.translation: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,

medium.name: An-Nasr
medium.translation: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.

medium.name: Al-Masad
medium.translation: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.

hard.name: Al-Fatihah
hard.translation: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: They think to beguile Allah and those who believe, and they beguile none save themselves; but they perceive not.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil).

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you, and fulfil your (part of the) covenant, I shall fulfil My (part of the) covenant, and fear Me.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Enjoin ye righteousness upon mankind while ye yourselves forget (to practise it)? And ye are readers of the Scripture! Have ye then no sense?

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And when We did appoint for Moses forty nights (of solitude), and then ye chose the calf, when he had gone from you, and were wrong-doers.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And ye know of those of you who broke the Sabbath, how We said unto them: Be ye apes, despised and hated!

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And We made it an example to their own and to succeeding generations, and an admonition to the Allah-fearing.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And (remember) when ye slew a man and disagreed concerning it and Allah brought forth that which ye were hiding.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And We said: Smite him with some of it. Thus Allah bringeth the dead to life and showeth you His portents so that ye may understand.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Are they then unaware that Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim?

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Among them are unlettered folk who know the Scripture not except from hearsay. They but guess.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And those who believe and do good works: such are rightful owners of the Garden. They will abide therein.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And they say: Our hearts are hardened. Nay, but Allah hath cursed them for their unbelief. Little is that which they believe.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And Moses came unto you with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), yet, while he was away, ye chose the calf (for worship) and ye were wrong-doers.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: But they will never long for it, because of that which their own hands have sent before them. Allah is aware of evil-doers.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Who is an enemy to Allah, and His angels and His messengers, and Gabriel and Michael! Then, lo! Allah (Himself) is an enemy to the disbelievers.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Verily We have revealed unto thee clear tokens, and only miscreants will disbelieve in them.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Is it ever so that when they make a covenant a party of them set it aside? The truth is, most of them believe not.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And if they had believed and kept from evil, a recompense from Allah would be better, if they only knew.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: O ye who believe, say not (unto the Prophet): "Listen to us" but say "Look upon us," and be ye listeners. For disbelievers is a painful doom.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: The Originator of the heavens and the earth! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) with the truth, a bringer of glad tidings and a warner. And thou wilt not be asked about the owners of hell-fire.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: When his Lord said unto him: Surrender! he said: I have surrendered to the Lord of the Worlds.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: (We take our) colour from Allah, and who is better than Allah at colouring. We are His worshippers.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness and prayer. Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And surely We shall try you with something of fear and hunger, and loss of wealth and lives and crops; but give glad tidings to the steadfast,

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Who say, when a misfortune striketh them: Lo! we are Allah's and lo! unto Him we are returning.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Such are they on whom are blessings from their Lord, and mercy. Such are the rightly guided.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Except those who repent and amend and make manifest (the truth). These it is toward whom I relent. I am the Relenting, the Merciful.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Lo! Those who disbelieve, and die while they are disbelievers; on them is the curse of Allah and of angels and of men combined.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: They ever dwell therein. The doom will not be lightened for them, neither will they be reprieved.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Your Allah is One Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: (On the day) when those who were followed disown those who followed (them), and they behold the doom, and all their aims collapse with them.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: He enjoineth upon you only the evil and the foul, and that ye should tell concerning Allah that which ye know not.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Those are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, and torment at the price of pardon. How constant are they in their strife to reach the Fire!

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Then hasten onward from the place whence the multitude hasteneth onward, and ask forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: For them there is in store a goodly portion out of that which they have earned. Allah is swift at reckoning.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And of mankind is he who would sell himself, seeking the pleasure of Allah; and Allah hath compassion on (His) bondmen.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: And if ye slide back after the clear proofs have come unto you, then know that Allah is Mighty, Wise.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Fight in the way of Allah, and know that Allah is Hearer, Knower.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth, and lo! thou art of the number of (Our) messengers;

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: A kind word with forgiveness is better than almsgiving followed by injury. Allah is Absolute, Clement.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: Allah hath blighted usury and made almsgiving fruitful. Allah loveth not the impious and guilty.

hard.name: Al-Baqarah
hard.translation: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah, and give up what remaineth (due to you) from usury, if ye are (in truth) believers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: He hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture with truth, confirming that which was (revealed) before it, even as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Lo! nothing in the earth or in the heavens is hidden from Allah.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Say (O Muhammad) unto those who disbelieve: Ye shall be overcome and gathered unto Hell, an evil resting-place.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Those who say: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire;

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Those are they whose works have failed in the world and the Hereafter; and they have no helpers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Say: Obey Allah and the messenger. But if they turn away, lo! Allah loveth not the disbelievers (in His guidance).

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran above (all His) creatures.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred thee above (all) the women of creation.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Our Lord! We believe in that which Thou hast revealed and we follow him whom Thou hast sent. Enrol us among those who witness (to the truth).

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: As for those who disbelieve I shall chastise them with a heavy chastisement in the world and the Hereafter; and they will have no helpers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And as for those who believe and do good works, He will pay them their wages in full. Allah loveth not wrong-doers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: A party of the People of the Scripture long to make you go astray; and they make none to go astray except themselves, but they perceive not.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: O People of the Scripture! Why confound ye truth with falsehood and knowingly conceal the truth?

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: He selecteth for His mercy whom He will. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Nay, but (the chosen of Allah is) he who fulfilleth his pledge and wardeth off (evil); for lo! Allah loveth those who ward off (evil).

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And whoso seeketh as religion other than the Surrender (to Allah) it will not be accepted from him, and he will be a loser in the Hereafter.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: As for such, their guerdon is that on them rests the curse of Allah and of angels and of men combined.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: They will abide therein. Their doom will not be lightened, neither will they be reprieved;

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Save those who afterward repent and do right. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And whoever shall invent a falsehood after that concerning Allah, such will be wrong-doers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Say: Allah speaketh truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, the upright. He was not of the idolaters.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Lo! the first Sanctuary appointed for mankind was that at Becca, a blessed place, a guidance to the peoples;

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Say: O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah, when Allah (Himself) is Witness of what ye do?

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah with right observance, and die not save as those who have surrendered (unto Him)

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And as for those whose faces have been whitened, in the mercy of Allah they dwell for ever.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: These are revelations of Allah. We recite them unto thee in truth. Allah willeth no injustice to (His) creatures.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and unto Allah all things are returned.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: They will not harm you save a trifling hurt, and if they fight against you they will turn and flee. And afterward they will not be helped.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And whatever good they do, they will not be denied the meed thereof. Allah is Aware of those who ward off (evil).

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And when thou settedst forth at daybreak from thy housefolk to assign to the believers their positions for the battle, Allah was Hearer, Knower.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: When two parties of you almost fell away, and Allah was their Protecting Friend. In Allah let believers put their trust.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Allah had already given you the victory at Badr, when ye were contemptible. So observe your duty to Allah in order that ye may be thankful.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: When thou didst say unto the believers: Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should support you with three thousand angels sent down (to your help)?

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: That He may cut off a part of those who disbelieve, or overwhelm them so that they retire, frustrated.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: It is no concern at all of thee (Muhammad) whether He relent toward them or punish them; for they are evil-doers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: O ye who believe! Devour not usury, doubling and quadrupling (the sum lent). Observe your duty to Allah, that ye may be successful.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who ward off (evil);

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Systems have passed away before you. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for those who did deny (the messengers).

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Faint not nor grieve, for ye will overcome them if ye are (indeed) believers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Or deemed ye that ye would enter paradise while yet Allah knoweth not those of you who really strive, nor knoweth those (of you) who are steadfast?

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And verily ye used to wish for death before ye met it (in the field). Now ye have seen it with your eyes!

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: So Allah gave them the reward of the world and the good reward of the Hereafter. Allah loveth those whose deeds are good.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: O ye who believe! if ye obey those who disbelieve, they will make you turn back on your heels, and ye turn back as losers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: There are degrees (of grace and reprobation) with Allah, and Allah is Seer of what they do.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: That which befell you, on the day when the two armies met, was by permission of Allah; that He might know the true believers;

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: They rejoice because of favour from Allah and kindness, and that Allah wasteth not the wage of the believers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: It is only the devil who would make (men) fear his partisans. Fear them not; fear Me, if ye are true believers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Those who purchase disbelief at the price of faith harm Allah not at all, but theirs will be a painful doom.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: This is on account of that which your own hands have sent before (you to the judgment). Allah is no oppressor of (His) bondmen.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: And if they deny thee, even so did they deny messengers who were before thee, who came with miracles and with the Psalms and with the Scripture giving light.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. Allah is Able to do all things.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Lo! In the creation of the heavens and the earth and (in) the difference of night and day are tokens (of His Sovereignty) for men of understanding,

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: Our Lord! Whom Thou causest to enter the Fire: him indeed Thou hast confounded. For evil-doers there will be no helpers.

hard.name: Ali 'Imran
hard.translation: O ye who believe! Endure, outdo all others in endurance, be ready, and observe your duty to Allah, in order that ye may succeed.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: And when kinsfolk and orphans and the needy are present at the division (of the heritage), bestow on them therefrom and speak kindly unto them.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: And whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger and transgresseth His limits, He will make him enter Fire, where he will dwell for ever; his will be a shameful doom.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: How can ye take it (back) after one of you hath gone in unto the other, and they have taken a strong pledge from you?

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: And Allah would turn to you in mercy; but those who follow vain desires would have you go tremendously astray.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Allah would make the burden light for you, for man was created weak.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: If ye avoid the great (things) which ye are forbidden, We will remit from you your evil deeds and make you enter at a noble gate.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: But how (will it be with them) when We bring of every people a witness, and We bring thee (O Muhammad) a witness against these?

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Allah knoweth best (who are) your enemies. Allah is sufficient as a Guardian, and Allah is sufficient as a Supporter.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: See, how they invent lies about Allah! That of itself is flagrant sin.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Those are they whom Allah hath cursed, and he whom Allah hath cursed, thou (O Muhammad) wilt find for him no helper.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Or have they even a share in the Sovereignty? Then in that case, they would not give mankind even the speck on a date-stone.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: And of them were (some) who believed therein and of them were (some) who turned away from it. Hell is sufficient for (their) burning.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: O ye who believe! Take your precautions, then advance the proven ones, or advance all together.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Whoso obeyeth the messenger hath obeyed Allah, and whoso turneth away: We have not sent thee as a warder over them.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Degrees of rank from Him, and forgiveness and mercy. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Except the feeble among men, and the women, and the children, who are unable to devise a plan and are not shown a way.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: As for such, it may be that Allah will pardon them. Allah is ever Clement, Forgiving.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Yet whoso doeth evil or wrongeth his own soul, then seeketh pardon of Allah, will find Allah Forgiving, Merciful.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Whoso committeth sin committeth it only against himself. Allah is ever Knower, Wise.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: They invoke in His stead only females; they pray to none else than Satan, a rebel

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Whom Allah cursed, and he said: Surely I will take of Thy bondmen an appointed portion,

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Allah ever surroundeth all things.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: But if they separate, Allah will compensate each out of His abundance. Allah is ever All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. And Allah is sufficient as Defender.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: If He will, He can remove you, O people, and produce others (in your stead). Allah is Able to do that.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Lo! the hypocrites (will be) in the lowest deep of the Fire, and thou wilt find no helper for them;

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: What concern hath Allah for your punishment if ye are thankful (for His mercies) and believe (in Him)? Allah was ever Responsive, Aware.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Such are disbelievers in truth; and for disbelievers We prepare a shameful doom.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: But Allah took him up unto Himself. Allah was ever Mighty, Wise.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Lo! those who disbelieve and hinder (others) from the way of Allah, they verily have wandered far astray.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Lo! those who disbelieve and deal in wrong, Allah will never forgive them, neither will He guide them unto a road,

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: Except the road of hell, wherein they will abide for ever. And that is ever easy for Allah.

hard.name: An-Nisa
hard.translation: O mankind! Now hath a proof from your Lord come unto you, and We have sent down unto you a clear light;

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: Allah hath promised those who believe and do good works: Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: But (the other's) mind imposed on him the killing of his brother, so he slew him and became one of the losers.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah, and seek the way of approach unto Him, and strive in His way in order that ye may succeed.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: They will wish to come forth from the Fire, but they will not come forth from it. Theirs will be a lasting doom.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: Is it a judgment of the time of (pagan) ignorance that they are seeking? Who is better than Allah for judgment to a people who have certainty (in their belief)?

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: Your guardian can be only Allah; and His messenger and those who believe, who establish worship and pay the poordue, and bow down (in prayer).

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: And whoso taketh Allah and His messenger and those who believe for guardian (will know that), lo! the party of Allah, they are the victorious.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: And when ye call to prayer they take it for a jest and sport. That is because they are a folk who understand not.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: If only the People of the Scripture would believe and ward off (evil), surely We should remit their sins from them and surely We should bring them into Gardens of Delight.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: Will they not rather turn unto Allah and seek forgiveness of Him? For Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: They restrained not one another from the wickedness they did. Verily evil was that they used to do!

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: Eat of that which Allah hath bestowed on you as food lawful and good, and keep your duty to Allah in Whom ye are believers.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: Know that Allah is severe in punishment, but that Allah (also) is Forgiving, Merciful.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: The duty of the messenger is only to convey (the message). Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: A folk before you asked (for such disclosures) and then disbelieved therein.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: And when I inspired the disciples, (saying): Believe in Me and in My messenger, they said: We believe. Bear witness that we have surrendered (unto Thee) "we are muslims".

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: If Thou punish them, lo! they are Thy slaves, and if Thou forgive them (lo! they are Thy slaves). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise.

hard.name: Al-Ma'idah
hard.translation: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is therein, and He is Able to do all things.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth. He knoweth both your secret and your utterance, and He knoweth what ye earn.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Never came there unto them a revelation of the revelations of Allah but they did turn away from it.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: And they denied the truth when it came unto them. But there will come unto them the tidings of that which they used to deride.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Had we appointed him (Our messenger) an angel, We assuredly had made him (as) a man (that he might speak to men); and (thus) obscured for them (the truth) they (now) obscure.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Messengers (of Allah) have been derided before thee, but that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Say (unto the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever resteth in the night and the day. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Say: I fear, if I rebel against my Lord, the retribution of an Awful Day.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: He from whom (such retribution) is averted on that day, (Allah) hath in truth had mercy on him. That will be the signal triumph.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: And on the day We gather them together We shall say unto those who ascribed partners (unto Allah): Where are (now) those partners of your make-believe?

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Then will they have no contention save that they will say: By Allah, our Lord, we never were idolaters.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: See how they lie against themselves, and (how) the thing which they devised hath failed them!

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: And they forbid (men) from it and avoid it, and they ruin none save themselves, though they perceive not.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: And they say: There is naught save our life of the world, and we shall not be raised (again).

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Only those can accept who hear. As for the dead, Allah will raise them up; then unto Him they will be returned.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Nay, but unto Him ye call, and He removeth that because of which ye call unto Him, if He will, and ye forget whatever partners ye ascribed unto Him.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: We have sent already unto peoples that were before thee, and We visited them with tribulation and adversity, in order that they might grow humble.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: So of the people who did wrong the last remnant was cut off. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Then are they restored unto Allah, their Lord, the Just. Surely His is the judgment. And He is the most swift of reckoners.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Say: Allah delivereth you from this and from all affliction. Yet ye attribute partners unto Him.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Thy people (O Muhammad) have denied it, though it is the Truth. Say: I am not put in charge of you.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Those who ward off (evil) are not accountable for them in aught, but the Reminder (must be given them) that haply they (too) may ward off (evil).

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: And to establish worship and be dutiful to Him, and He it is unto Whom ye will be gathered.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Thus did We show Abraham the kingdom of the heavens and the earth that he might be of those possessing certainty:

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Lo! I have turned my face toward Him Who created the heavens and the earth, as one by nature upright, and I am not of the idolaters.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Those who believe and obscure not their belief by wrongdoing, theirs is safety; and they are rightly guided.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot. Each one (of them) did We prefer above (Our) creatures,

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: With some of their forefathers and their offspring and their brethren; and We chose them and guided them unto a straight path.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: He is the Cleaver of the Daybreak, and He hath appointed the night for stillness, and the sun and the moon for reckoning. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Vision comprehendeth Him not, but He comprehendeth (all) vision. He is the Subtile, the Aware.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: We confound their hearts and their eyes. As they believed not therein at the first, We let them wander blindly on in their contumacy.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: That the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter may incline thereto, and that they may take pleasure therein, and that they may earn what they are earning.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Perfected is the Word of thy Lord in truth and justice. There is naught that can change His words. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Lo! thy Lord, He knoweth best who erreth from His way; and He knoweth best (who are) the rightly guided.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Eat of that over which the name of Allah hath been mentioned, if ye are believers in His revelations.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Forsake the outwardness of sin and the inwardness thereof. Lo! those who garner sin will be awarded that which they have earned.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: This is the path of thy Lord, a straight path. We have detailed Our revelations for a people who take heed.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: For them is the abode of peace with their Lord. He will be their Protecting Friend because of what they used to do.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: This is because thy Lord destroyeth not the townships arbitrarily while their people are unconscious (of the wrong they do).

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: For all there will be ranks from what they did. Thy Lord is not unaware of what they do.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: So if they give the lie to thee (Muhammad), say: Your Lord is a Lord of All-Embracing Mercy, and His wrath will never be withdrawn from guilty folk.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Say - For Allah's is the final argument - Had He willed He could indeed have guided all of you.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: Say: Lo! my worship and my sacrifice and my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

hard.name: Al-An'am
hard.translation: He hath no partner. This am I commanded, and I am first of those who surrender (unto Him).

hard.name: Al-A'raf
hard.translation: (It is) a Scripture that is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) - so let there be no heaviness in thy heart therefrom - that thou mayst warn thereby, and (it is) a Reminder unto believers.

hard.name: Al-A'raf
hard.translation: How many a township have We destroyed! As a raid by night, or while they slept at noon, Our terror came unto them.

hard.name: Al-A'raf
hard.translation: No plea had they, when Our terror came unto them, save that they said: Lo! We were wrong-doers.

hard.name: Al-A'raf
hard.translation: The weighing on that day is the true (weighing). As for those whose scale is heavy, they are the successful.

hard.name: Al-A'raf
hard.translation: And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls because they used to wrong Our revelations.

hard.name: Al-A'raf
